item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of any nuclear capability, nuclear signaling, or nuclear coercion by Tshisekedi. I also found no evidence of nuclear threats, brinkmanship, or attempts to use nuclear weapons as cover for conventional force or repression. The best-supported conclusion is therefore: not applicable in practice, with no evidence of misuse. It also notes an IAEA safeguards agreement in force.
